card.name: First digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A digit that begins or sits in the middle of a multi-digit number, so that another digit (often 0) is expected next. Seen in doses, lab values, weights and years.

card.writes: It favors digits such as 0 and 9 and the ″ and ′ marks next, so a number continues, and it suppresses word endings.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that is not finished yet, such as the 4 in 40 mg.
